code: DEBUG_printf(("_cupsRasterExecPS(h=%p, preferred_bits=%p, code=\"%s\")\n", h, preferred_bits, code));
note: The input buffer becomes the PostScript code string consumed by the interpreter.
The interpreter uses an attacker-controlled stack count without validating that the stack contains at least that many objects before copying.
The copy source index is derived from the requested count; when the count exceeds the current stack depth, the operation should stop before any object reuse.
The stack copy reads from a stack slot that may already have been popped, producing the heap-use-after-free read reported by ASan.
